item.title: github: Track GitHub Code Quality enablement changes in the audit log
item.description:
GitHub Code Quality now emits audit log events when it is enabled, disabled, or its repository settings are changed. This adds a history trail for Code Quality configuration changes.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Restrict issue creation to collaborators only
item.description:
Repository admins can now limit issue creation to collaborators with write access. This adds control over who can open issues and helps reduce unwanted issue creation.

  • Source: GitHub
